summaryZh: Brashier实验室研究记忆失误和认知捷径为何使人容易相信错误信息。它使用行为与神经成像工具，考察年轻人和老年人为何受到虚假新闻影响。
researchQuestions: 哪些记忆失误和认知捷径使人容易接受错误信息？

evidence.quote: We study the memory failures and cognitive ‘shortcuts’ that leave people vulnerable to misinformation. Our lab at UC San Diego uses both behavioral and neuroimaging tools to investigate why young and older adults fall for fake news.
